mapper.select: SELECT * FROM paiflow_python_history_snapshot WHERE run_id=#{run} AND attempt=#{attempt}
SELECT model_operation_id,evidence_json,evidence_hash FROM paiflow_python_history_evidence WHERE run_id=#{run} AND attempt=#{attempt} AND request_key_hash=#{key}
SELECT question_json,answer_json FROM paiflow_node_history WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT OCTET_LENGTH(m.parameters_json)+OCTET_LENGTH(m.approval_json)+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(f.frame_json)) FROM paiflow_model_frame f WHERE f.operation_id=m.id),0) AS bytes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paiflow_model_frame f WHERE f.operation_id=m.id) AS row_count FROM paiflow_model_operation m WHERE m.id=#{operation}
SELECT id FROM paiflow_model_operation WHERE run_id=#{run} LIMIT 1001
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(request_json)+OCTET_LENGTH(binding_json)+COALESCE(OCTET_LENGTH(response_json),0)),0) AS bytes,COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM paiflow_tool_operation WHERE run_id=#{run}

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(response_json)) FROM paiflow_data_request WHERE run_id=#{run}),0)+COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(completion_json)),0) AS bytes,COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM paiflow_data_completion WHERE run_id=#{run}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(request_json)+OCTET_LENGTH(response_json)),0) AS bytes,COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM paiflow_variable_source WHERE run_id=#{run}
SELECT request_hash,revision FROM paiflow_node_history WHERE run_id=#{run} AND attempt=#{attempt} AND request_key_hash=#{key}
SELECT * FROM paiflow_java_node_history WHERE run_id=#{run} AND attempt=#{attempt} AND node_id=#{node}
